name: moderne
description: Find and run OpenRewrite recipes and search code across your Moderne organizations, with guidance for writing recipes and reading Prethink context

setup.notice: Requires a Moderne account and works only on repositories already ingested into your Moderne tenant. The server is in beta, and its tools do not commit code or open pull requests.
steps: In the Moderne Platform, open Account settings, select Access Tokens, and generate a personal access token.
